decision.name: P0_2_SINGLE_WRITER_FAIL_STOP_PUBLICATION_ATOMICITY
decision.finding: Pinned P0 covers completed concurrent writers and P0.5 archive-to-output causality; neither asserts crash/exception consistency after first output replacement. Exact runner.py:142-144 publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json sequentially. A failure at audit publication after a complete T0 generation leaves T1/T0/T0 visible. No versioned snapshot reader or fail-closed read protocol identified. This is a distinct deterministic single-writer integration completeness gate, not a witnessed test failure.
decision.pytest_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow import runner

def test_interrupted_publication_keeps_last_complete_generation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    t0, t1 = 1800000000000, 1800000060000
    runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=t0)
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    def stamps():
        return [json.loads((tmp_path / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["as_of_ms"] for name in names]
    assert stamps() == [t0, t0, t0]
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    blocked = []
    def fail_audit(path, payload):
        if Path(path).name == "audit_latest.json":
            blocked.append("audit")
            raise RuntimeError("injected_audit_write_failure")
        return original(path, payload)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", fail_audit)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected_audit_write_failure"):
        runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=t1)
    assert blocked == ["audit"]
    assert stamps() == [t0, t0, t0], "interrupted writer exposed mixed committed generations"
decision.acceptance: Without an independently demonstrated fail-closed consumer snapshot protocol, interrupted T1 publication must preserve all T0 outputs. A source-predicted [T1,T0,T0] is expected RED, not measured. GREEN requires non-skipped test, exact public SHA, baseline+overlay full suite, exit codes, stdout/stderr and overlay hash. If a new explicit consumer protocol is introduced by authorized Gemini-only fix, require test to demonstrate rejection/retry of partial generation rather than simply relaxing stamps.
